description:
Show the account's current API rate limits: 'general' (most file operations), 'big_uploads' (chunked uploads over 95MB) and 'zip' (zip imports).

Each limit has the maximum, how many requests remain, and when the counter resets. Call this before bulk operations or after a 429 error.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

name: nekoweb_get_limits
title: Get rate limits
